serverless service.

like an identity
must be coming from
a specific CIDR range

if the vendor or partner is
on Google Cloud.

can layer, the less likely
a compromised credential
could be used to exfill data

So to recap.

listing for services you're

get an idea where to start,

products and limitations
page for each service

And for third parties

layer as many attributes as
possible to reduce the risk
from attack vectors like
compromised credentials.
To learn more about VPCs,
